name: linear
description: Manage your Linear issues, projects, labels, and comments.

api_key.description: Linear personal API key. Create one in Linear under Settings > Security and access > Personal API keys (https://linear.app/settings/account/security).

instructions: Set api_key to a Linear personal API key so the plugin can talk to your workspace. In Linear, open Settings > Security and access > Personal API keys, create a key, and copy it into this plugin's configuration. The key acts as your user and can read and write your Linear data, so treat it as a secret and do not share it.
